milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the honeycomb_block cluster (centered at ~7, ~1, ~8 on the front wall of the wooden shelter) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located the block. max_distance=16 is generous since the block is visible from moderate range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the honeycomb_block rather than facing away.
